162166.overview: The Gauntlet is a clone of the arcade game Scramble which is viewed from the side with the screen scrolling horizontally constantly from left to right for one to two players. You control a spacecraft and you must fly over a mountainous planet's surface bombing various installations while avoiding missiles that fly upwards. As well as your bombs you are also armed with a laser that fires forward. As you fly, a fuel gauge decreases and you need to bomb fuel dumps to keep your fuel levels up. If you are hit by a missile, crash into the surface or run out of fuel then you lose one of three lives and it's the 2nd players turn if two player is selected.

175519.overview: Ghost Hunt is a Pac-Man clone where you have to move around a maze viewed from above and eat all the dots to move to the next maze. As you move around there are four ghosts also moving around the maze and if you touch one then you lose one of three lives. As well as the dots you can collect power-pills that allow you to kill the ghosts for a limited time. A $ sign can also be collected which awards you bonus points and once the maze is cleared you receive an extra life.

175520.overview: Gulp 2 is a sequel to the game Gulp! where once again you have to move around various mazes eating all the dots to clear the mazes. The game is viewed from above with each maze seen on the whole screen. You are now chased by four Ogres and if you touch one then you lose one of nine lives but you are armed with a limited amount of lasers which fire in all four directions. Before you start you have a number of options that can be chosen and they are, pick one of 15 mazes, Tempo (1-9) and Grade (1-9). You also have a choice of two control methods and you can watch a demo.

175522.overview: Gobbleman is a clone of the arcade game Pac-Man and has you attempting to clear a maze by eating all the dots while avoiding four ghosts. If you touch one of the ghosts then you lose one of three lives but there are power-pills that can be collected to let you eat the ghosts for a short time. The maze is viewed from above shown on the whole screen.
